name: The Burden
_notes: Transcribed from sheet BU1149 (front Lv I / back Lv II-IX), AI BR1110-BR1130, BP BS1131-BS1148, Routine Impostor's Gaze BR1130, Signature Rolling Failure BR1129.

Mnestis simplification (user): victory only by killing the Burden (Wounds); the Peak / Battle Track is ignored. Forsaken Mountain: column 20 is the top, column 1 the bottom; Titans reaching column 20 are NOT removed.

Kickback = Knockback that bounces 90° off obstacles/Primordial (towards column 1 when possible), Crash once at the end. Rewind = move the Titan back to the space they started this Round (interpretation: last start-of-turn position).
Zone patterns: Tides of the Lethe / Umbral Dunk = Zone 2 / Zone 3 after a Jump onto the target. Sequential Attack = targets attacked one by one, highest column first.

Tethered implemented (path distance around Obstacles; "above/below" = strictly higher/lower column). Ties That Bind Us: a Titan outside the limit cannot move voluntarily (every space is a Chasm) and falls if it is involuntarily moved again; it is safe again once other Titans bring it back within the limit. Mnemos-node stealing is still campaign-only.
Theatre: Not Yet... is ignored (Rewind enabled) — user.

traits.Kickback X: Resolve like Knockback X, with the following exceptions. If you move onto an obstacle Terrain tile or the Primordial, you bounce off of it! Change the move's direction by 90 degrees (so it's parallel to the feature) and continue to resolve the remaining Kickback (you may bounce several times). If possible, change direction so that you move towards the bottom of the Board (column 1). If you suffer Crash during Kickback, you suffer it once, at the end of Kickback.
traits.Sisyphus's Spiral: When the Burden moves adjacent to its Target, if it is not above the Target (i.e. isn't positioned in higher columns than the Target), it swivels clockwise around the Target, so that it ends up on the four spaces directly above the Target (in higher columns). If the movement is blocked by the Board Edge, the Burden moves onto the Target's space instead and the Target is Displaced onto a lower space adjacent to the Burden.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Splash: When a Titan suffers Crash as a result of Primordial movement, they additionally gain 1 Ambrosia token.
traits.Moirai Vault: Place stolen Gear, Mnemos cards and tokens on this Trait; they cannot be used. If you Wound a Fateless Eye BP, instead of dealing a Wound, you may take 1 thing from the Moirai Vault. Then discard the BP card and gain +1 Fate.
traits.Burden Hardest to Bear: Remove the Sisyphean Task AI card from the Battle. Additional Setup: Each Titan gains a Sisyphean Condition card. When you deal a Wound, discard a Sisyphean Condition card from your Titan.
traits.Ties That Bind Us: Titans can be involuntarily moved outside the Tethered limit. If at any point a Titan is outside the Tethered limit, it treats all spaces as Chasms until it returns within the limit.
traits.Antisherpa: Titans in columns 1-7 are dealt +2 Danger per hit. Titans in columns 8-15 are dealt +1 Danger per hit.
traits.Icecapade: Disable abilities that allow to treat Slippery tiles as one tile. If you end the Primordial Round or your Titan turn on a Slippery space, move towards the lowest column until you are no longer on a Slippery space. Additional Setup: Alternate Battle Diagram (Rulebook Mnestis Battle Diagrams, Burden Lv 5+).
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Slippery Slope: +3 to all Kickbacks performed by the Burden.
traits.Mountain of Madness: Treat the Cliffs marked as red on the diagram as Boundless Board Edges.
traits.Timefront Beckons: Start of Battle: Place the Timefront tiles on the bottom column (1). End of Titan Round: ⚡ Move the Timefront 3 spaces up (towards the highest column). If the Timefront moves onto a space occupied by a Titan, this Titan is erased from existence. If the Timefront moves onto a space with a Terrain tile, this tile is destroyed (unless Indestructible). When the Timefront is about to move onto a space occupied by the Primordial, move the Primordial directly away from the Timefront.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.The Game is Rigged: If a Titan ends their turn with the Sisyphean Condition, they die. End of Primordial Round: Burden performs Heal.
traits.Tethered: Titans are tethered with ropes. They cannot move in a way that would cause them to be more than 10 spaces (counting around Obstacles) away from the closest Titan above and below them (unless there is no other Titan above/below). If a Titan would be involuntarily moved more than 10 spaces away, this movement immediately stops. If Titans end up more than 10 spaces apart, they can only move towards one another until they adhere. At the end of the Titan Round, if any Titans are more than 10 spaces away from the Titans above or below them, kill Titans until all remaining Titans adhere.
